name: Western Plaguelands
currently: Argent Crusade patrols and Cenarion restoration crews have reopened key roads and fields in Western Plaguelands, but Andorhal remains a militarized flashpoint and nearby settlements still plan around Scourge remnants. Hearthglen and Caer Darrow routes stay active under escort discipline, and local stability depends on constant patrol rotations rather than durable peacetime conditions. Farmers and caravan teams continue to coordinate movement windows with armed protection, and emergency watch schedules remain standard across reclaimed holdings where undead pressure can return without warning.
history: Before the Third War, Western Plaguelands served Lordaeron as a grain and trade heartland centered on Andorhal. Cult of the Damned infiltration and plague distribution transformed that network into contested undead territory, followed by prolonged control struggles among Scourge forces, Scarlet remnants, and anti-plague campaigns. After Wrath and into Cataclysm continuity, reclamation expanded under Argent and Cenarion efforts, yet conflict legacies around Andorhal and Scholomance-adjacent corridors kept security uneven and governance fragile. Control shifts, repeated sieges, and infrastructure collapse left local institutions under constant strain, and even successful recovery pushes were repeatedly tested by renewed military pressure, blight damage, and difficult supply coordination across exposed routes. Long-running disputes over strategic roads, farm recovery priorities, and garrison rotation commitments slowed stabilization, while repeated emergency mobilizations drained manpower that communities needed for rebuilding and food security. These conditions preserved a persistent sense of instability despite measurable territorial gains.

major_questlines_alliance.title: Alliance Andorhal Campaign
major_questlines_alliance.hook: Alliance forces contest Andorhal through sustained siege pressure, militia coordination, and repeated assaults to secure command points, protect civilians, and stabilize nearby supply routes under constant enemy resistance. The campaign emphasizes difficult command decisions, attrition management, and repeated efforts to hold reclaimed ground against renewed attacks.

inclusion_decision.decision_reason: Alliance Andorhal beats remain pilot-critical with sourced coverage.

major_questlines_horde.title: Forsaken Andorhal Campaign
major_questlines_horde.hook: Forsaken commanders coordinate counteroffensives, route control, and reinforcement timing to secure strategic ground during the Battle for Andorhal, balancing attrition tactics with rapid response to shifting frontline threats. Their arc highlights aggressive redeployment, pressure maintenance, and high-stakes leadership choices in contested urban terrain daily.

inclusion_decision.decision_reason: Horde mirror beats capture contested Andorhal logistics.

major_questlines_shared.title: Hearthglen Security Arc
major_questlines_shared.hook: Regional defenders maintain patrol corridors around Hearthglen and nearby farms while responding to recurring undead pressure, convoy disruptions, and localized security failures that threaten civilian movement and recovery operations. The effort focuses on route discipline, emergency coordination, and preserving fragile progress in recently reclaimed areas.

inclusion_decision.decision_reason: Shared recovery corridor beats reinforce coalition framing.
